statement: The Committee cut the policy rate by 50 basis points to 3.75% as inflation has fallen below target and output is materially below potential.
rationale: Inflation 1.69% is 0.31pp below 2% target and falling fast (-0.93pp last quarter). Output gap -1.12% and widening (-0.85pp). Real rate ~2.6% (4.25-1.69) is ~1.6pp above neutral 1.0%, highly restrictive. Taylor rule at 3.0% confirms stance too tight. Markets orderly (no halts/margin calls, small drawdown), so 50bp cut to 3.75% still leaves policy mildly restrictive while providing needed support to return inflation to target and close gap over medium term. Lags mean Q4 inflation largely predetermined lower; act now to avoid deeper undershoot.
notes: Cut 50 to 3.75 in Q3 on sharp fall in inflation/gap. Still restrictive (real ~2%). Watch Q4 gap/inflation response; further cuts likely toward ~2.75 neutral if weakness persists.

statement: Inflation has fallen to 0.9% with a persistent negative output gap; we are cutting 75bp to 2.5% to support a return to 2% inflation and full employment.
rationale: Inflation fell to 0.94% (1.41% prior) and gap at -0.97, both ~1pp below mandate. Real rate 3.25-0.94=2.31% vs 1% neutral = still ~1.3pp restrictive, weighing on gap next quarter and inflation after. Taylor rule at 2.0% confirms need to ease substantially. Markets calm (return +332bps, drawdown 0.25%, no halts/margin calls) so can focus on macro; cut also lifts wealth supporting demand. 75bp to 2.5% moves decisively toward neutral/accommodative while retaining room to cut further if disinflation persists; will watch Q6 gap/inflation response.

statement: The Committee reduced the policy rate to 0.75% to support activity and return inflation toward the 2% target.
rationale: Inflation at 0.72% is >1pp below 2% target and output gap at -1.19% remains deeply negative, with weakness persisting across Q4-Q8 despite prior easing. statement: The Committee is holding the policy rate at 0.75% to sustain the recovery in activity and inflation toward target.

statement: The Committee cut the policy rate to 0.50% as inflation remains well below target and spare capacity persists.
rationale: Inflation at 0.94% is ~1pp below 2% target for 6 quarters and output gap still negative at -0.3 with progress slowing (+0.14). Current 0.75% is accommodative (real -0.19 vs 1% neutral) but disinflation persists, so 25bp cut adds support. Taylor rule 1.0% would tighten prematurely and risk stalling gap closure; markets calm (1.4% drawdown, no halts) so no financial constraint, and small equity boost aids wealth channel. Keeps stance clearly supportive to lift gap to ~0 and inflation toward 2% over lag horizon.
